agentGuide: Base path /v2. Account: GET /v2/account; balance: GET /v2/customers/my/balance. Droplets: GET /v2/droplets?per_page=50 (id, name, status, networks.v4[].ip_address, size_slug, region.slug); one: GET /v2/droplets/<id>; actions: POST /v2/droplets/<id>/actions {"type": "power_on"} (power_off, reboot, shutdown, snapshot). Create: POST /v2/droplets {"name": "...", "region": "fra1", "size": "s-1vcpu-1gb", "image": "debian-12-x64", "ssh_keys": [..]} — it costs money. Catalogue: GET /v2/sizes, /v2/images?type=distribution, /v2/regions, /v2/account/keys. Domains: GET /v2/domains, records: GET /v2/domains/<name>/records, add: POST ... {"type": "A", "name": "www", "data": "1.2.3.4"}. Apps (App Platform): GET /v2/apps; databases: GET /v2/databases; volumes: GET /v2/volumes; firewalls: GET /v2/firewalls. Monitoring: GET /v2/monitoring/metrics/droplet/cpu?host_id=<id>&start=&end=. The token is set by Allkin.
